purpose: detailed modeling references from previous BOKI appearance sheets

prompts.prompt: Create a new DETAILED BLENDER MODELING TURNAROUND using the attached Boki design strictly as identity/clothing reference. Same exhausted adult student face, short dark hair, purple windbreaker with acid lime V/chevron stripes, black shirt, dark pants, worn pale sneakers, black digital watch on character LEFT wrist. Landscape 3:2 technical sheet on very light warm gray, neutral studio light, no shadows obscuring contour. Upper 70% three equally sized full body ORTHOGRAPHIC front, RIGHT side, back with aligned head, shoulders, pelvis, knees and foot baselines. FRONT and BACK in identical relaxed A-pose arms 35 degrees down from horizontal, hands spread away from thighs, legs straight feet parallel at hip width. Side true profile no perspective. Keep same actual body volumes and clothing seams in all views. Crisp 3D low-poly mesh rendering with modest faceted PS1 geometry and low-res painted textures, more detailed than a silhouette, not high-poly. Lower 30% front/profile head close-ups with matching nose, ears, brow, jaw and hair cap; one jacket shoulder/elbow mesh wireframe patch; left wrist watch detail 07:58. Minimal precise construction grid at consistent head units, no huge text panels. No scooter in this sheet, no combat weapons, no new accessories, no watermark. New reference illustration, not executable mesh.

Keep consistent part shapes and sizes, no realistic physics mechanism, no extra weapons, no motorbike seat, no extra wheels. Faceted economical PS1 modeling reference, clean thin dark construction lines, neutral lighting, minimal tiny part labels only, no branding, no watermark. Do not bake any headlight beam or laser into the geometry illustration; small emitter panels enough.
